description: Scenario inputs for the fictional startup FairSwipe. These are pricing decisions and assumptions, not published facts. Every value here is editable on the site.

notes.processing_cost_usd: FairSwipe's own cost to authorize, settle and support one transaction. Scenario assumption.
notes.network_fee_pct: Card-brand assessment fee charged by Visa or Mastercard. Not published as one citable figure, so it is an adjustable assumption.
notes.debit_fraud_adjustment_usd: Added to the regulated debit interchange rate when the issuer qualifies for the fraud-prevention adjustment (Visa interchange schedule).

plans.name: Growth
plans.target: Online sellers up to about $75K a month
